Name: “Talk of the Town” Commemorative Painting
Description:
To commemorate a strange event from years past, when Aeternians collectively shared a vision of Big Sausage. On the frame’s back is scrawled this poem:


<font face="lyshineui/fonts/Pica_Italic.font">Solemnly ground, eyes over-glazed,

Enraptured in reverence amidst smoky haze.

A link to such ecstasy is hardly a first

From which to be cured is simply the wurst.

So savor our savior without gristly flaw,

For frankly even one cursed haven’t the gall

To be filled with anything but awe:

Ode to sausage, the greatest brat of all.</font>
